_comment: Personality traits. A key ending in Mult scales a number (1 = no change); any other key adds to it. enabled=false keeps a designed trait out of the offers until all of it is built.

traits.name: Silent Lunatic
traits.good: Monsters notice you from half as far away.
traits.bad: Each turn a hostile is in view you may fly into a Berserk rage. Spells cost 50% more MP.

traits.name: Angry Genius
traits.good: +3 Intelligence. +25% experience. Spells cost 1 less MP (minimum 1).
traits.bad: You take 20% more damage. 10% of your attacks fail outright.

traits.name: Stoic Clown
traits.good: HP regenerates 30% faster. You cannot be confused, put to sleep or made to hallucinate.
traits.bad: Shop prices are 25% worse. Crit chance -5%.

traits.name: Lucky Fool
traits.good: +4 Luck, which also nudges your crit chance up.

traits.name: Greedy Scholar
traits.good: +50% Divinities from kills and new chunks. You sell items for 25% more.
traits.bad: You buy items for 25% more. -1 Constitution.

traits.name: Reckless Duelist
traits.bad: Armour class -2. Dodge chance is halved.

traits.name: Cowardly Alchemist
traits.good: Healing from potions, food and spells is 50% stronger.

traits.name: Paranoid Scout
traits.good: Carried light radius +1.5. Mimic detection +25 points.
traits.bad: Resting at the bed restores only half your missing HP and MP.

traits.name: Night Owl
traits.good: +2 light radius underground. +10% dodge below the surface.
traits.bad: Light is 1 tile shorter on the surface. -1 Wisdom.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.good: Immune to poison and sickness. Raw monster flesh cannot hurt you.
traits.bad: You choke on food 10 points of fullness sooner than others do.

traits.name: Ghost Whisperer
traits.good: +20% Magic Resistance. Damage spells do +2 damage per die to the undead.
traits.bad: Monsters notice you from 25% farther away.

traits.name: Hardy Cynic
traits.good: Maximum HP +25%. Poison and bleeding hurt half as often.

traits.name: Born Coward
traits.bad: Your weapon does 2 less damage to a monster that is hunting you and right beside you.

traits.name: Lucky Pariah
traits.good: Crit chance +10%. Gold and gems you find are worth 30% more.
traits.bad: Shopkeepers will not trade with you.

traits.name: Hollow Prophet
traits.good: Learns spells from books one level early. Spell cost -25%.

traits.name: Bloodsoaked Saint
traits.good: Heals 1 HP for every 4 damage you deal in melee.
traits.bad: You are 25% more likely to suffer a lasting wound.
